classification.difficultyReason: Convert two lengths to centimetres before adding the increase to the original width.

content.prompt: Joe widens a $1.2\text{ m}$ doorway by $50\text{ mm}$. What is the new width of the doorway, in centimetres?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}
\text{Original width} &= 1.2\times100\text{ cm} \\
\text{Original width} &= 120\text{ cm} \\
\text{Increase} &= 50\div10\text{ cm} \\
\text{Increase} &= 5\text{ cm} \\
\text{New width} &= (120+5)\text{ cm} \\
\text{New width} &= 125\text{ cm}
\end{align*}$$
